note: Sharper v5 voice, latest two matches. Independently reviewed against raw facts.

e89f68db-2b84-4433-b02c-2ffbf6cb43f4.headline: A proper fucking finish.
e89f68db-2b84-4433-b02c-2ffbf6cb43f4.team: We repeatedly followed won fight sequences with objectives or structures, then finished through their base. The ugly Mini Prime exchange still belongs in the review; winning the game does not turn every trade into genius.

focus.title: Cash the win
focus.action: After the next won fight, name the nearest safe objective or structure and take it. Another kill is optional; progress toward the Core is the point.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow did the fucking job: team-leading damage and kills, without a mountain of deaths. Keep that balance and keep hitting the targets that can be reached safely. Make this level of output and survival repeatable.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock farmed hard and rarely died. Keep the income and survival; carry the same restraint into the next close game, when a death buys more than a mildly annoying walk back.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Iggy & Scorch brought the money, objective damage and survival. Keep feeding the economy and helping finish structures. Do not sacrifice that useful work just to fluff a hero-damage number. The Core does not give a shit how pretty the damage chart looks.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Lt. Belica put wards down and contributed to kills. Keep doing the support work that actually shows up in the result. Before the next contest, name the retreat condition and stick to it; the early death to Revenant is the reminder that a win does not make every decision untouchable.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera did the heavy lifting on objective damage and kept the farm moving. Preserve that pressure. Before the next neutral take, make the exit call explicit; the early Mini Prime exchange is the reminder that getting the buff and getting a good trade are different damn things.

9.3.call: The kill sequence ended 1-3. Mini Prime was secured afterward; the objective take does not establish that the deaths were avoidable or worthwhile.

15.6.call: The kill sequence ended 3-0. Mini Prime was secured during it, an Outer Tower followed, and Fangtooth came later.

24.7.call: The final kill sequence ended 5-2 while enemy structures fell. Their Core fell shortly afterward.

768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.headline: They took the map. We took the loss.
768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.team: The enemy collected the major neutrals and tore through our structures, while our won skirmishes produced no quick objective return. That is a fucking miserable exchange rate, and a respectable-looking personal score does not fix it.

focus.title: Give the next fight a purpose
focus.action: Before committing, name the objective or structure the fight can secure or defend. If there is no reachable prize, call the reset instead of treating another kill as the whole plan.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wukong supplied strong hero damage and cleared enemy wards, then placed none himself. Keep the damage and denial, but put a damn ward down on a safe approach before the next objective setup. Removing their information does not magically create ours.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Revenant kept farm and deaths in decent shape, but hero damage fell below the usual output. Keep the survival; make sustained damage the next practice target. Drill attacks between reloads and repositioning, then bring that rhythm into fights. A tidy score is not a carry-performance certificate.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett led ward placement and kept deaths low, but contributed no objective damage. Keep the vision and survival; after the next won exchange, check for a safe tower or neutral to hit. Staying alive is useful. Finding something useful to do with it is the next assignment.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gideon contributed damage and still finished with the team's most deaths. Keep the output; before the next commitment, name the exit condition and leave when it is met. The build matching a recommendation does not make the rest of the game fucking correct.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel supplied the team's strongest mitigation and plenty of assists, but deaths ran above the usual level. Keep the contribution; make the next commitment about protecting a named teammate or securing a clear objective, with a disengage call. Being support is not a license to donate his ass.

10.7.call: Enemy Fangtooth was taken before the kill sequence began; the subsequent sequence ended 1-4.

25.call: Gideon died to Crunch. Two Inner Towers and an Inhibitor fell afterward; event timing alone does not establish that the death caused those losses.

31.call: The final kill sequence ended 1-2 immediately before the Core fell. Kill credits do not establish who was present.
